correctness.rationale: For every time slice, the squared STFT magnitude has exactly the character coefficients at \(0,\pm a\). Since \(L\ge4\), the \(a\) and \(-a\) characters are distinct, so the measurements recover both \(s_x=|f_x|^2+|f_{x+a}|^2\) and \(c_x=f_x\overline{f_{x+a}}\). If \(\tilde f\) has the same data, the ratios \(q_x=\tilde f_x/f_x\) obey \(q_x\overline{q_{x+a}}=1\), forcing a common phase and alternating reciprocal moduli around each even step cycle. Equality of the recovered sums factors as \((r^2-1)(r^2|f_x|^2-|f_{x+a}|^2)=0\); the nontrivial branch therefore forces constant magnitudes on each parity class and gives exactly the level swap. The converse preserves every recovered coefficient. The exact-rational verifier checks all eligible steps through \(N=120\), but the complete classification follows from these algebraic equations.
